name: Katharina Julia Brenner
headline: AI for Biomanufacturing
summary: I work at the intersection of AI, biotechnology, and bioprocess scale up. My focus is on modeling and decision intelligence for next generation biomanufacturing. I am particularly interested in how complex biotechnologies can be translated into scalable systems, better process decisions, and real industrial deployment.

company.name: Future Foods
company.description: Future Foods is a TUM initiative that brings professionals and students into the world of alternative proteins and cutting-edge food technologies 🌱. We dive into cultured meat, precision fermentation, and even machine learning, offering hands-on workshops, product development projects, and hackathons 🚀. Our goal is to blend theory with practical skills, giving students and professionals the tools to innovate and tackle real-world challenges in food tech 👩🏻‍🔬. We're here to equip the next generation of scientists and engineers with the expertise they need for future-focused careers in biosciences and technology 🧪🥼. Join us and help shape the future of food! 🌎
